notes: «أبي» is the first link, named only by relation to the compiler, so kind relation (rule 7)
«ياسين الضرير [أ] وغيره»: the bracketed [أ] is an editor's mark, left out; «وغيره» (and others) is an unnamed co-transmitter in the same level (rule 8)
«عن أبيه عليهما السلام» is a bare relation, so the Imam is not named in the chain; the saying is his report
